samplingConvention: Source-reviewed central tissue contours, native40 Y280..320, assigned at 0.5 mm cell centres. Edges have partial volume. No morphology, gap filling or laterality split of old ID33.

before.method: marching cubes 0.5; no smoothing, resampling, filling or component removal
before.scope: section-view BigBrain selection/context only; not expert validation

after.method: marching cubes 0.5; no smoothing, resampling, filling or component removal
after.scope: section-view BigBrain selection/context only; not expert validation

limitation: Central optic chiasm remains partial; full boundaries, optic nerve/tract transitions and fibre trajectories are not established. Tissue-centre sampling includes edge partial volume. Not expert-reviewed.

primaryReview.rationale: Thirteen native40 coronal, sagittal and horizontal footprint views support the thicker central interior traced in the previously reviewed v2 contours. Centre sampling permits teaching-scale partial-volume edges. Existing 112 cells remain; 52 unlabelled and 206 legacy ID33 cells are added to ID36 from source-image evidence, not a coordinate split. The result is one component without morphological gap filling.
